spec2def(wuauserv.dll wuauserv.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# wuauserv.dll is all Rust (wuauserv-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/wuauserv-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# wuauserv.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/wuauserv-rust/src/wuauserv/wuauserv.rs)
add_cargo_module(wuauserv wuauserv-cargo wuauserv.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE wuauserv-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
